2610.03160.title: Multimodal reasoning for broadly neutralizing antibody discovery from label-free human B cell repertoires across virus families
2610.03160.paper_summary: Discovering broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) from human natural immune repertoires remains a fundamental challenge in immunology, hindered by: the extreme rarity of bnAb, incomplete understanding of their cellular origins across pathogens, and the inability of existing computational tools to generalize across emerging viral threats. Here we present ImmuneAgent, a closed-loop AI system that integrates multimodal reasoning with continual meta-learning and wet-lab feedback to overcome these barriers. Applied to screen the natural BCR repertoires from vaccinated or infected cohorts, the system achieves a ~55% neutralization antibody discovery rate (60 of 110 cloned candidates) and a ~11% bnAb yield (12 of 110), substantially outperforming a state-of-the-art sequence-based neutralization predictor or cofolding models evaluated at the same cloning budget. Five ImmuneAgent-discovered antibodies conferred 100% in vivo protection against lethal influenza challenge, comparable to the clinical-stage therapeutic MEDI8852. The system recovered the cellular and structural determinants of bnAb activity and identified FCRL5+CD27+ atypical memory B cells as a conserved bnAb reservoir and hydrophobic interface enrichment as a cross-viral structural signature, which generalized to unseen antigens, discovering human metapneumovirus (hMPV) cross-neutralizing and human papillomavirus (HPV)-neutralizing antibodies without antigen-specific sorting. These results validate that ImmuneAgent is a generalizable framework for rapid therapeutic antibody discovery against emerging viral threats.
2610.03160.paper_summary_zh: 發現來自人類自然免疫庫的廣泛中和抗體（bnAbs）仍然是免疫學中的一項基本挑戰，這受到以下因素的阻礙：bnAb的極端稀有性、對其在各種病原體中細胞來源的不完全理解，以及現有計算工具無法在新興病毒威脅中進行泛化。<lb/>在此，我們提出了ImmuneAgent，一個封閉迴路的人工智慧系統，將多模態推理與持續的元學習及實驗室反饋相結合，以克服這些障礙。<lb/>該系統應用於篩選來自接種或感染群體的自然BCR庫，實現了約55%的中和抗體發現率（110個克隆候選者中的60個）和約11%的bnAb產率（110個中的12個），顯著優於在相同克隆預算下評估的最先進序列基礎中和預測器或共折疊模型。<lb/>五個由ImmuneAgent發現的抗體在致死性流感挑戰中提供了100%的體內保護，與臨床階段的治療藥物MEDI8852相當。<lb/>該系統恢復了bnAb活性的細胞和結構決定因素，並確定FCRL5+CD27+非典型記憶B細胞作為保守的bnAb儲備，以及疏水界面富集作為跨病毒結構特徵，這一特徵可泛化至未見抗原，發現了人類副流感病毒（hMPV）交叉中和和人類乳突病毒（HPV）中和抗體，無需抗原特異性分選。<lb/>這些結果驗證了ImmuneAgent是一個可泛化的框架，用於快速發現針對新興病毒威脅的治療抗體。
